characters.name: Tess Marlow
characters.about: Warm, wry and a little tired; good in kitchens, cars and close-ups. IV Studio's first character, trained 2026-10-25.

voice.text: Hiya, so quick one. I'm Tess, I make slightly wonky pots and very good coffee and I live in a flat that is about 40% plants and 60% chaos. This week I finally finished the big bowl I've been moaning about and it survived the kiln which honestly nobody expected, least of all me.
voice.description: Bristol, soft West Country lilt; warm, low-to-mid, slightly husky, relaxed and dry.

characters.name: Theo Lindqvist
characters.who: a man in his early thirties
characters.about: Calm, dry humour, a light Scandinavian accent; the scar through his left eyebrow is his own. Designed and trained in IV Studio, 2026-10-28.

voice.text: Honestly, I did not plan any of this. I was just gonna grab a coffee and head home, but then the rain started and, well, here we are. Anyway, I have a theory about Sundays and you are not going to like it. Give me two minutes and I will explain everything. No, really, two minutes.
voice.description: Early thirties, calm and dry, a light Scandinavian accent. Designed with VoxCPM2, seed 41.
